I have thoroughly explored the repository. Here are my findings.

## Repository overview
This is a Spring PetClinic REST fork (`spring-petclinic-rest`) with a parallel OfficeFloor ("woof") implementation. All date-derived owner values are computed by small, single-purpose static helper classes under one package:

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/`

These are wired into the JSON response via a MapStruct mapper (`OwnerMapper.java`). Note: there is currently **no `fiscalYear` implementation** — a test asserts it (see item 5), so it appears to be a feature yet to be built.

---

## 1. Membership identifier with a year segment
**File:** `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/MembershipNumber.java`
- Class: `MembershipNumber` (final, private constructor — pure utility). **Only one method**: `static String of(String customerCode, LocalDate registrationDate)`. Cyclomatic complexity 1 (no branching). Tiny class (~17 lines).
- Format: `<customerCode>-M<YY>` where YY = last two digits of the registrationDate year.

```java
public static String of(String customerCode, LocalDate registrationDate) {
    return String.format("%s-M%02d", customerCode, registrationDate.getYear() % 100);
}
```
Wired at `OwnerMapper.java:29-30` (target `membershipNumber`). Also logged in `SaveOwner.java:20`.

---

## 2. Tenure (365-day window from registration date)
**File:** `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/MembershipTier.java`
- Class: `MembershipTier` (final, private constructor). **Three methods**: private `hasTenure(LocalDate)`, public `points(Integer, String, LocalDate)`, public `level(int)`. ~52 lines. `points` has several sequential `if`s (complexity ~5); `level` is a 4-way cascade (complexity ~4); `hasTenure` complexity ~2.
- Tenure = days between `registrationDate` and `LocalDate.now()` > 365, contributing 3 points.

```java
private static boolean hasTenure(LocalDate registrationDate) {
    return registrationDate != null
            && ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(registrationDate, LocalDate.now()) > 365;
}
```
`points` also adds 2 for email present, 1 for `namesakeCount == 0`, 2 for `namesakeCount >= 2`, 3 for tenure. `level` maps points → 1/2/3/4. Wired at `OwnerMapper.java:33-36` (`membershipPoints`, `membershipLevel`) and logged in `SaveOwner.java:18-19`.

---

## 3. Business-day-adjusted registration date
**File:** `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/BusinessDay.java`
- Class: `BusinessDay` (final, private constructor). **Two methods**: public `static LocalDate roll(LocalDate)` and private `static boolean isNonBusinessDay(LocalDate)`. ~34 lines. `roll` has a while loop (complexity ~2); `isNonBusinessDay` is a 3-way boolean OR (complexity ~3). A hardcoded `HOLIDAYS` set for 2026 (New Year, Australia Day, ANZAC, Christmas, Dec 28).

```java
public static LocalDate roll(LocalDate date) {
    while (isNonBusinessDay(date)) {
        date = date.plusDays(1);
    }
    return date;
}
private static boolean isNonBusinessDay(LocalDate date) {
    DayOfWeek day = date.getDayOfWeek();
    return day == DayOfWeek.SATURDAY || day == DayOfWeek.SUNDAY || HOLIDAYS.contains(date);
}
```

**Applied in:** `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/BuildOwner.java` (`service(...)`, lines 11-17): defaults a null registration date to today, then rolls it onto a business day before saving:
```java
java.time.LocalDate effective = owner.getRegistrationDate() == null
    ? java.time.LocalDate.now() : owner.getRegistrationDate();
owner.setRegistrationDate(BusinessDay.roll(effective));
```
The test mirror of this logic is `AcceptanceBase.toBusinessDay(...)` and its `HOLIDAYS` set (see item 5).

---

## 4. Registration date (general)
- **Validation:** `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/RequireCurrentRegistrationDate.java` — class `RequireCurrentRegistrationDate`, single method `service(@Val OwnerFieldsDto)`. Rejects a future `registrationDate` (later than `LocalDate.now()`) with `FutureRegistrationDateException`. Complexity ~2.
- **Escalation/exception:** `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/escalation/FutureRegistrationDateException.java` (extends `Exception`) and `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/escalation/FutureRegistrationDateExceptionHandler.java` (`handle(...)` → HTTP 400). Registered via `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/officefloor/escalation/org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.escalation.FutureRegistrationDateException.yml`.
- **Model field:** `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java:62-63,142-148` — `registrationDate` column plus getter/setter. `Owner` is a large JPA entity (~272 lines, ~30 methods including pet management), so complexity concentration is in `getPet`/`getPets`, not the date logic.
- **Consumed by other derived values:** `AgeBand.of(birthDate, registrationDate)` at `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AgeBand.java` (age band measured against registration date), plus `MembershipNumber`, `MembershipTier` above.
- **OpenAPI docs:** `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml` — `registrationDate` at line 2065; `membershipNumber` (2153), `membershipPoints` (2167), `membershipLevel` (2175), `ageBand` (2202). No `fiscalYear` property is defined here.

---

## 5. Tests related to membership id / tenure / fiscal year
**File:** `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java`
- Class `AcceptanceTest extends AcceptanceBase`. The class Javadoc states the objective: *"fiscal-year: Move date-derived values to a fiscal-year basis, where the fiscal year starts on 1 July."* One test:
```java
@Test
void coreReturnsFiscalYear() throws Exception {
    int id = createOwnerOk(structuredOwner());
    JsonNode n = fetchOwner(id);
    assertTrue(n.get("fiscalYear").asText().matches("FY\\d{2}"));
}
```
This asserts a `fiscalYear` field of form `FY\d{2}` that does **not yet exist** in `OwnerMapper`, `OwnerDto`/openapi, or any function class — i.e. the feature to implement.

**Base class:** `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceBase.java` — black-box `@SpringBootTest @AutoConfigureMockMvc @Transactional @WithMockUser` harness driving `POST /api/owners` + `GET /api/owners/{id}`. Directly relevant helpers:
- `toBusinessDay(LocalDate)` (lines 268-274) and the `HOLIDAYS` set (lines 240-242) — the test-side mirror of `BusinessDay`.

**File:** `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/MembershipTier.java`

```java
private static boolean hasTenure(LocalDate registrationDate) {
    return registrationDate != null
            && ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(registrationDate, LocalDate.now()) > 365;
}
```

```java
public static LocalDate roll(LocalDate date) {
    while (isNonBusinessDay(date)) {
        date = date.plusDays(1);
    }
    return date;

private static boolean isNonBusinessDay(LocalDate date) {
    DayOfWeek day = date.getDayOfWeek();
    return day == DayOfWeek.SATURDAY || day == DayOfWeek.SUNDAY || HOLIDAYS.contains(date);
```

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: Optional honorific of the pet owner (MR, MRS, MS or DR).
          type: string
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Composed from the structured
            address fields when those are supplied; otherwise accepted as-is for
            backward compatibility.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: First line of the structured address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' when present; an owner is valid with either form.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: Optional second line of the structured address.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: Optional 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the current server date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: Optional date of birth of the pet owner. When present, drives the derived ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allow creating this owner even if another owner has the same lastName and address (a shared household). Request-only; not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's title and last name ('DR who'), or just the last name when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans - country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Server-assigned code 'LAST3-NNNN' — the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and a global 4-digit sequence.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Stable identifier shared by owners with the same lastName and address (a shared household).
              type: string
              example: 'H-1a2b3c'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: Derived duplicate-detection key 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (email empty when absent).
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george@example.com|H-1a2b3c'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Server-derived code '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: Number of existing owners (before this owner was created) sharing the same firstName and lastName, case-insensitively.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: "Points scored on creation: +2 when an email is present, +1 when namesakeCount is 0, +2 for a household of 3 or more, +3 for tenure over 365 days."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: "Numeric level mapped from membershipPoints: 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5), 4 (6 or more)."
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: "Canonical region derived from city (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN'."
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: "IANA timezone derived from locality (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent for an unknown region."
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: "'EMAIL' when an email address is present, otherwise 'PHONE'."
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: "Derived from birthDate against registrationDate: 'MINOR' (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65+). Absent when no birthDate was supplied."
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true

              description: "True when this owner shares an existing owner's lastName and postcode but has a different telephone (a soft match); otherwise false."

              readOnly: true
            deleted:

              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:

              readOnly: true
          required:

## Summary

I moved the owner's date-derived values onto a fiscal-year basis (fiscal year starts 1 July), keeping the change small and localized.

**New unit — `FiscalYear.java`** (small, cohesive utility, no surrounding complexity):
- `of(date)` → fiscal year (ending calendar year; month ≥ July ⇒ year+1)
- `label(date)` → `"FY<YY>"`
- `elapsed(from, to)` → whole fiscal years between two dates

**Edits (each a one-line change inside a simple method, so structural impact stays low):**
- `MembershipNumber.of` — year segment now uses `FiscalYear.of(...)` instead of the raw calendar year.
- `MembershipTier.hasTenure` — tenure now counts elapsed fiscal years (`> 0`) instead of a 365-day window; dropped the now-unused `ChronoUnit` import.
- `openapi.yml` — added the read-only `fiscalYear` property to the `Owner` schema (generates `OwnerDto.fiscalYear`).
- `OwnerMapper` — added one `@Mapping` wiring `fiscalYear` to `FiscalYear.label(owner.getRegistrationDate())`, derived from the already business-day-adjusted stored registration date.

I deliberately did not touch the large `Owner` entity or grow any existing method; the fiscal-year logic lives entirely in the new helper, so the two mandated behavior changes (`MembershipNumber`, `MembershipTier`) each reduced to a single call-site swap.

The new `coreReturnsFiscalYear` acceptance test and the full suite pass (`Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`, `BUILD SUCCESS`).
